bio: Bootshaus is located in the heart of Hamburg's HafenCity. From the comfortable Boot (boat) dining area, watch the action in the open kitchen or look out over the marina (Grasbrookhafen) from the light and airy bar area. In summer the waterfront terrace beckons. The Josper grill takes centre stage, with cuts such as New York strip, rib-eye and porterhouse cooked to perfection! There is also a large selection of side dishes and delicious sauces. Keep an eye out for the seafood specials and the Chef's Choice deal. The early opening times (from 5.30pm) make this an ideal spot for dinner before a concert at the nearby Elbphilharmonie – or perhaps a drink at the bar afterwards....
